node.statement: Under the three stated conditional hypotheses, let 0!=Z in M_n tensor S_P. Isometry of i gives i(Z)!=0 and ||i(Z)||=||Z||; intertwining and isometry of j give ||h_m(i(Z))||=||j(h_n(Z))||=||h_n(Z)||. By the definition of a_m as the infimum of ||h_m(Y)||/||Y|| over nonzero Y, a_m<=||h_m(i(Z))||/||i(Z)||=||h_n(Z)||/||Z||. Taking the infimum over nonzero Z yields a_m<=a_n.
